source_manifest.publisher: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
source_manifest.reuse: Public domain unless otherwise indicated; source attribution required
source_manifest.transformations: ND omitted without forward fill; returns span consecutive available observations, including holiday gaps. No equity corporate actions apply. Reference quotes, not executable prices. Latest historical vintage, not point-in-time vintage.

protocol.selection: fixed methods and parameters; no search or tuning
protocol.scope: retrospective chronological evaluation on latest vintage; not untouched prospective holdout; two correlated FX pairs

evidence.protocol: rolling one-observation-ahead; zero mean; no future observations
limitations: Squared one-step return is a noisy variance proxy
Normal tails can underestimate crisis risk
Coverage non-rejection is not proof of correct calibration
No parameter tuning or trading-profit claim
